notes_for_editor: The whole record is one short entry on a hobbyist lookout site (Forest Lookouts), with no page of its own. It gives no date for the transfer to the state and no later history. Two web searches found no other description of a Hoffman tower; the results were other towers (Warren County, Chenocetah) that do not match. The tower index lists NCT089 with the benchmark code '0 bm'. Current status and access are unknown.
